query:
SELECT EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1 FROM agent_tags t JOIN agents g ON g.id = t.agent_id
                      WHERE g.name = ?1 AND t.tag = 'main'
                  ) AS "holds_main!: bool",
                  (SELECT w.role FROM worker_processes w JOIN agents g ON g.id = w.agent_id
                   WHERE g.name = ?1) AS "role?: String"
